status_semantics.implemented: Product implementation of the complete named row; partial diagnostics do not qualify
status_semantics.built: true only with build evidence; null means unknown
status_semantics.flown: true only for exact pinned candidate and stated scenario; null means unverified
status_semantics.admitted: requestable in this v1 slice; no Cartesian-product compatibility inference

legacy_v1.provenance: Immutable historical flight pins; existing installed snapshots do not claim full hashing during those flights

session_v1.snapshot_provenance: Read-only installed snapshot after the two pinned flights; all relative file names and bytes except __pycache__ and .pyc. Flight results separately hash all eight installed control Python sources. Schema/build artifacts were not fully hashed during historical flights.

known_unflown_candidates.reason: Built successfully, no flight evidence; source equivalence does not promote binary identity

capabilities.name: PX4_SITL
capabilities.reason: 通过TCP连接标准PX4软件在环 — 当前自主物理与原生任务链已部分证明；正式产品入口及参考模式操作映射仍需验收

capabilities.name: PX4_SITL_RFLY

capabilities.name: Simulink&DLL_SIL
capabilities.reason: 无飞控的纯模型运行 — 自主模型有局部构建证据；完整选择、初始化、运行、重置及导出流程另行验收，不要求日常运行必须启动Simulink

capabilities.name: PX4_HITL_NET
capabilities.reason: 网络连接实体PX4硬件在环 — 硬件/网络和安全授权先决；手册免费版标签不一致不影响它属于Full范围

capabilities.name: EXT_HITL_COM
capabilities.reason: MAVLink串口接外部飞控 — 先明确一个可核验外部飞控和接口，不将“外部”解释为任意厂商任意设备

capabilities.name: EXT_SIM_NET
capabilities.reason: 连接外部仿真系统 — 先明确一个参考系统、物理权威、时钟和失败语义，再做单系统端到端票

capabilities.name: APM_SITL_NET
capabilities.reason: 连接ArduPilot软件在环 — 当前ArduCopter物理/任务候选有证据；不泛化为所有ArduPilot机型或原厂模式全兼容

capabilities.name: PX4_SIH_COM
capabilities.reason: SIH串口流程 — 需实体设备与对应固件；物理位于飞控内部，必须重新映射显示/任务时间而非再启动第二物理核心

capabilities.name: PX4_SIH_NET

capabilities.name: PX4_SIH_SITL
capabilities.reason: 软件飞控内运行SIH — 先核对固定PX4的该模式及接口，验证唯一物理权威和时间映射；当前外部物理SITL不覆盖它

capabilities.name: PX4_SIH_FLY

capabilities.name: UDP_Full

capabilities.name: UDP_Simple
